title: Advanced acoustic workshop
text:
Workshop · Námskeið · 5–8 October 2026

Advanced acoustic workshop
Framhaldsnámskeið í hljóðmælingum
Marine and Freshwater Research Institute, Hafnarfjörður


Four days on calibration, ADCP operation, acoustic scrutiny with Korona and LSSS, biomass estimation in R, AI for data processing, and MFRI acoustic data in the cloud — closing with project work and a field trip to Teledyne Gavia.


Venue · Staðsetning MFRI / Hafrannsóknastofnun Meeting room, 1st floor, by the canteen Fundarsalur á 1. hæð við mötuneytið


Dates · Dagsetningar Mon 5 – Thu 8 October 2026 Daily 08:30–16:30 MFRI project 9277


Contact · Umsjón [Teresa Silva, Sigurður Þ. Jónsson] [teresa.silva@hafogvatn.is] +354 575 2000
